title: DynaMiCS: Fine-tuning LLMs with Performance Constraints using Dynamic Mixtures
authors_zh: Eleonora Gualdoni, Sonia Laguna, Louis Béthune, Joao Monteiro, Pierre Ablin, Marco Cuturi
paper_type_zh: 带约束的动态监督微调数据混合优化研究
best_for_zh: 在专门化数据与明确安全或能力保持约束间取平衡的读者。
one_line: DynaMiCS repeatedly probes data-source effects and optimizes SFT mixture weights to improve targets without violating protected capabilities.
DynaMiCS 反复探测数据来源效应并优化监督微调混合权重，在改善目标的同时不违反受保护能力。
why: It makes protected evaluation domains part of the data-consumption decision.
inclusion_reason: It dynamically decides how source-level SFT records enter training while enforcing explicit preservation constraints on held-out capabilities.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Specializing an LLM through SFT can improve a target domain while eroding safety, factual knowledge, commonsense reasoning, or instruction following. Fixed mixtures of target and auxiliary data cannot react when transfer turns into interference during training, and a grid search over mixtures becomes expensive as the number of available sources grows. Existing adaptive mixers may change weights, but they do not directly encode a requirement that protected capabilities remain above a reference level.

DynaMiCS asks how to decide the next source-level SFT mixture when some evaluation domains must improve and others must not degrade. Its data object is a batch sampled from one of several named fine-tuning datasets; its evaluation object can be a held-out loss or a non-differentiable metric on a constrained domain. The contribution is a policy for consuming those source datasets under explicit performance constraints, not a new benchmark or a release of a new general-purpose corpus.

通过监督微调专门化大语言模型可以改善目标领域，却可能损害安全、事实知识、常识推理或指令遵循。目标和辅助数据的固定混合无法在训练中迁移变成干扰时作出反应，而可用来源增多时，网格搜索混合比例的成本会迅速上升。既有自适应混合器可能改变权重，但它们不直接编码受保护能力必须高于参考水平的要求。

DynaMiCS 追问当一些评测领域必须改善、另一些不得退化时，如何决定下一段监督微调的来源级混合。其数据对象是从若干命名微调数据集之一抽出的批次；其评估对象可以是留出损失，或约束领域上的不可微指标。贡献是在显式性能约束下消费这些来源数据集的策略，而不是新的基准或新的通用语料发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method estimates a local slope matrix of cross-domain effects. Starting from the current model, it temporarily trains for a few steps on each fine-tuning dataset alone, restores the model and optimizer state, and measures how every target and constrained evaluation changes. A negative slope means beneficial transfer for an evaluation domain; a positive slope signals interference or potential forgetting.

At each update, the slope matrix becomes a short-horizon linear prediction of each evaluation loss under candidate mixture weights. The optimizer minimizes predicted target losses while penalizing a constrained domain if its predicted loss rises above the base-model reference. The resulting weights are used only until the next scheduled probe, so the mixture can first emphasize target data and later shift toward auxiliary data that regularizes preservation.

方法估计跨领域效应的局部斜率矩阵。它从当前模型出发，分别只在每个微调数据集上临时训练若干步，恢复模型和优化器状态，再测量每个目标和受约束评测如何变化。负斜率表示对某个评测领域有益的迁移；正斜率表示干扰或潜在遗忘。

在每次更新中，斜率矩阵成为候选混合权重下每个评测损失的短期线性预测。优化器最小化预测的目标损失，同时在受约束领域的预测损失超过基础模型参考时施加惩罚。得到的权重只使用到下一次预定探测，因此混合可以先强调目标数据，之后转向有助于保持能力的辅助数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
Fine-tuning sources are separated from evaluation domains. Evaluation domains are partitioned into targets and constraints, and need not be included in the training mixture. At every update, DynaMiCS probes each available source with the current optimizer for a small number of steps, evaluates the temporary checkpoint on all domains, and uses the finite differences to fill the slope matrix. It then solves a probability-simplex problem with a squared-hinge penalty for predicted constraint violations; when no feasible solution exists, the least-violating mixture is selected.

The paper evaluates fifty scenarios with one to three targets and three to ten constraints, covering math, code, instruction following, medical QA, function calling, multilingual data, safety, commonsense reasoning, and general knowledge. It uses Qwen2.5-3B at LoRA ranks 8, 32, and 64, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma3-12B, each trained for 2,048 steps with batch size 8. Geometric schedules re-estimate the mixture more often early in training; the paper also tests accuracy constraints, showing that the finite-difference signal does not require a differentiable evaluation metric.

微调来源与评测领域被分开。评测领域被划分为目标和约束，无须包含在训练混合中。每次更新时，DynaMiCS 用当前优化器在每个可用来源上探测少量步骤，评估临时检查点在所有领域上的表现，并用有限差分填充斜率矩阵。随后它在概率单纯形上求解带预测约束违反平方铰链惩罚的问题；当不存在可行解时，选择违反最少的混合。

论文评测五十个场景，含一到三个目标和三到十个约束，覆盖数学、代码、指令遵循、医学问答、函数调用、多语数据、安全、常识推理和通用知识。它使用 LoRA 秩为 8、32 和 64 的 Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen3-8B 和 Gemma3-12B，每个模型以批次大小 8 训练 2,048 步。几何调度在训练早期更频繁地重估混合；论文还测试准确率约束，说明有限差分信号不需要可微评测指标。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evaluation spans fifty scenarios, five model configurations, and three random seeds, totaling more than 7,000 fine-tuning runs. On Qwen2.5-3B, light and dense warmup schedules reach median target perplexity reductions of 8–9%, compared with 0.4% for best-of-ten fixed mixtures. On Qwen3-8B, DynaMiCS reaches 11% while the fixed baselines are at 0%; on Gemma3-12B, it reaches about 24%, versus 18% for the stronger fixed baseline. Infeasible runs contribute zero, so these measurements include both target improvement and the ability to satisfy all constraints.

The paper reports that a single adaptive run costs about 1.4–1.7 times one fixed run, while a ten-run mixture search costs ten times the baseline and still often fails to find a feasible checkpoint on Qwen models. Early updates matter: for Qwen3-8B, adding early probes raises median reduction from 5.8% to 11%. In four accuracy-constrained Gemma scenarios, the dense schedule finds feasible solutions in all four, although the tightest case has high seed variance. This evidence supports local, constraint-aware adaptation in the reported settings; it does not prove that the chosen constraint batches represent every capability a deployed model must retain.

评测涵盖五十个场景、五种模型配置和三个随机种子，共超过 7,000 次微调运行。在 Qwen2.5-3B 上，轻度和密集预热调度达到 8–9% 的中位目标困惑度下降，而十次固定混合中最佳的基线为 0.4%。在 Qwen3-8B 上，DynaMiCS 达到 11%，固定基线为 0%；在 Gemma3-12B 上，它达到约 24%，而较强固定基线为 18%。不可行运行计为零，因此这些测量同时包含目标改善和满足全部约束的能力。

论文报告，单次自适应运行成本约为一次固定运行的 1.4–1.7 倍，而十次混合搜索成本为基线十倍，且在 Qwen 模型上仍常找不到可行检查点。早期更新很重要：对 Qwen3-8B，加入早期探测使中位下降从 5.8% 提高到 11%。在四个带准确率约束的 Gemma 场景中，密集调度在四个场景均找到可行解，尽管最紧场景的随机种子方差很高。这些证据支持报告设置中的局部、约束感知自适应；它们不证明所选约束批次代表部署模型必须保留的每项能力。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Static mixtures decide data-source proportions before training, and many dynamic methods change those proportions from a reward, gradient, or controller signal without enforcing preservation. DynaMiCS changes the decision boundary by naming protected evaluation domains and treating their base-model performance as explicit constraints. It can use a benchmark that is never sampled as training data, so the training source and the capability being protected are deliberately separate objects.

Its distinctive mechanism is finite-difference probing followed by constrained mixture optimization. It is not simply a curriculum: temporary source-specific updates produce a matrix of transfer and interference estimates, and a penalty program converts that matrix into weights. The non-differentiable accuracy experiments matter because they show the signal can be defined by any repeatable evaluation, while the constrained formulation makes preservation a first-class part of the data-consumption decision.

静态混合在训练前决定数据来源比例，许多动态方法从奖励、梯度或控制器信号改变比例，却不强制保持能力。DynaMiCS 通过命名受保护的评测领域，并将其基础模型表现视为显式约束，改变了决策边界。它可以使用从未被抽作训练数据的基准，因此训练来源和被保护能力被有意设为分离对象。

独特机制是有限差分探测与约束混合优化。它不只是课程学习：临时的来源特定更新产生迁移和干扰估计矩阵，惩罚优化再将该矩阵转为权重。不可微准确率实验很重要，因为它表明信号可由任何可重复评测定义，而约束形式使保持能力成为数据消费决策的一等部分。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The local linear model assumes effects of sources combine additively and remain reliable until the next update; long intervals or strong joint interactions can violate that assumption. When constraints are numerous or tight, no feasible mixture may exist, and the greedy local strategy can over-specialize early and bias the remaining trajectory. Results also depend on the quality and coverage of evaluation domains: a narrow constraint set can leave unmeasured capabilities unprotected. The checked paper is an arXiv primary source and does not declare a dedicated code repository or a new standalone dataset release, so reproducing its 50 scenarios requires reconstructing data access, probes, metrics, and schedules from the paper.
局部线性模型假定来源效应可加并在下一次更新前保持可靠；长间隔或强联合交互可能违反该假定。当约束很多或很紧时，可能不存在可行混合，贪心局部策略也可能在早期过度专门化并偏置后续轨迹。结果还依赖评测领域的质量和覆盖面：狭窄约束集会使未测能力得不到保护。已核验论文是 arXiv 主要来源，未声明专用代码仓库或新的独立数据发布，因此复现五十个场景需要依据论文重建数据访问、探测、指标和调度。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use DynaMiCS when a team can name both the capabilities it wants to improve and the capabilities it must not lose, and can afford small repeated evaluations on each. Store the exact target and constraint definitions, base reference scores, probe budget, update schedule, optimization penalties, and source-mixture trajectory with every run. Compare against fixed mixtures at the same total compute, report feasibility separately from target improvement, and treat an infeasible result as a failure to fine-tune rather than silently selecting a high-target but unsafe checkpoint.
当团队能够命名既想改善的能力和绝不能失去的能力，并能承担对每个来源的小规模重复评测时，可使用 DynaMiCS。应将精确目标和约束定义、基础参考分数、探测预算、更新调度、优化惩罚和来源混合轨迹与每次运行一同保存。应在相同总计算量下与固定混合比较，分别报告可行性和目标改善，并把不可行结果视为微调失败，而不是悄悄选择目标高但不安全的检查点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key insight is that a data mixture is a constrained control decision, not merely a balance of domains. DynaMiCS uses evaluation-only domains to decide how to consume training sources, so the quality of that evaluation contract is at least as important as the candidate corpora. The most informative replication checks are the slope-prediction error over an update horizon, feasibility under held-out constraints, sensitivity to early updates, and whether a source that initially helps a target later becomes an interference source. The method is especially valuable when safety or retention must be measured alongside specialization rather than assumed from an average score.
关键洞见是，数据混合是受约束的控制决策，而不仅是领域平衡。DynaMiCS 使用仅评测的领域来决定如何消费训练来源，因此该评测契约的质量至少与候选语料同样重要。最有信息量的复现检查是更新跨度上的斜率预测误差、在留出约束下的可行性、对早期更新的敏感性，以及一个起初帮助目标的来源之后是否变成干扰来源。当安全或保持能力必须与专门化一同测量而不能由平均分假定时，该方法尤其有价值。
